name: Rex the Hunt!
review:
Dinosaurs on six reels with 178 connecting ways, wilds and a free spins bonus.

The 178 ways give the grid an unusual shape, and wilds help bridge the gaps between reels. Free spins are where the hunt pays off. High volatility, 4,000x cap, 96.16% RTP. Not a huge ceiling for the risk, but a fun theme.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
